report.problem: Agencies need efficient and automated tools for client reporting, but current solutions may have limitations in customization, integration, or cost-effectiveness, leading to manual work and dissatisfaction.
findings: Databox offers tiered pricing starting from a free plan for basic use, with agency-specific plans starting at $79/billed annually, including features like unlimited users and custom templates. Add-ons for branding and advanced security are available. ([https://databox.com/pricing](https://databox.com/pricing))

ReportGarden offers plans starting from $75/month with a 14-day free trial, emphasizing secure data, live integrations, and report automation. Data sources used in reports are counted towards usage. ([https://reportgarden.com/pricing](https://reportgarden.com/pricing))

There is a need to inspect alternatives and gaps in agency reporting tools, with searches indicating potential pain points around manual work and limitations in existing software. ([https://www.bing.com/search?q=Inspect%20alternatives%20and%20gaps%20in%20agency%20reporting%20tools](https://www.bing.com/search?q=Inspect%20alternatives%20and%20gaps%20in%20agency%20reporting%20tools))

Searches for 'agency reporting manual work complaints' and 'marketing agency client reporting pain points' suggest that manual effort and specific pain points are common issues. ([https://www.bing.com/search?q=agency%20reporting%20manual%20work%20complaints](https://www.bing.com/search?q=agency%20reporting%20manual%20work%20complaints), [https://www.bing.com/search?q=marketing%20agency%20client%20reporting%20pain%20points](https://www.bing.com/search?q=marketing%20agency%20client%20reporting%20pain%20points))

AgencyAnalytics is mentioned as a tool in this space, with searches for alternatives and pricing for small agencies. ([https://www.bing.com/search?q=AgencyAnalytics%20alternatives%20pricing%20small%20agencies](https://www.bing.com/search?q=AgencyAnalytics%20alternatives%20pricing%20small%20agencies))
uncertainties: The specific reporting limitations of tools like AgencyAnalytics are not detailed in the provided excerpts.
The exact nature of 'gaps' in current agency reporting tools requires further investigation.
The willingness to pay for specific features or solutions by small agencies is not quantified.
The effectiveness and user satisfaction with the AI features in tools like Databox are not elaborated upon.
The extent to which current tools address the pain points of manual work and reporting inefficiencies is unclear.
report.mvp: A dashboard that aggregates key performance indicators from multiple marketing channels (e.g., Google Analytics, social media, ad platforms) into a single, customizable view, with options for automated report generation and white-labeling for agencies.
report.nextExperiment: Conduct a survey or series of short interviews with marketing agency owners and managers to identify their top 3 reporting pain points and their current workarounds.
